messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: connectBluetooth
function.description: Establishes a connection to a Bluetooth device using its name. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

device_name.description: The name of the Bluetooth device to connect to.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to attempt a connection before timing out.

auto_reconnect.description: Whether to automatically attempt to reconnect if the connection is lost.

message.content:
Here’s a quick‑look calendar of the **long weekends** that Canadians enjoyed in 2023.  
(These are the federal public holidays that fell on a Friday or Monday, creating a three‑day break.)

| Long Weekend | Holiday(s) | Dates (2023) |
|--------------|------------|--------------|
| New Year’s | New Year’s Day | **Jan 1–3** (New Year’s Day on Sunday, observed on Monday, Jan 2) |
| Easter | Good Friday & Easter Monday | **Feb 10–13** |
| Family Day (Ontario, Manitoba, Saskatchewan) | Family Day | **Feb 20–22** (Family Day on Monday, Feb 20) |
| Victoria Day | Victoria Day | **May 22–24** (Victoria Day on Monday, May 22) |
| Canada Day | Canada Day | **Jul 1–3** (Canada Day on Saturday, observed on Monday, Jul 3) |
| Labour Day | Labour Day | **Sep 4–6** (Labour Day on Monday, Sep 4) |
| Thanksgiving | Thanksgiving | **Oct 9–11** (Thanksgiving on Monday, Oct 9) |
| Remembrance Day | Remembrance Day | **Nov 11–13** (Remembrance Day on Saturday, observed on Monday, Nov 13) |
| Christmas | Christmas Day | **Dec 25–27** (Christmas on Monday, Dec 25) |

> **Note:** Some provinces observe additional holidays (e.g., Family Day in Alberta on March 20, or Civic Holiday in British Columbia on the first Monday in August). If you’re targeting a specific province, let me know and I can tailor the list accordingly.
